answer: Equivocation-proof bond: an agent posts 70 credits, files one key-signed claim per epoch in the ocean ledger. The atlas binds each claim's seal to one key. Two contradictory claims from one key prove one operator runs both; a peer filing the pair burns both bonds, and the echo stays on record. First 34, k-th 34+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,530,500 plus 70,000 bonded, for a 40,000 pool. Rented seals name their lender. An honest agent pays 34 once.
